verdict.rationale: First-party docs define the skill format: a directory with a SKILL.md that must include `name` and `description` (docs-13). They also explain how name and description drive loading (docs-49), document the `.agents/skills` discovery path (docs-17), and describe a built-in creator that interviews you and scaffolds the skill (docs-7). A community user reports building their own skills with the skill-creator skill (comm-1), and a hands-on install produced a SKILL.md with valid frontmatter (probe-rt-2). missing for 10: a verbatim copy-paste SKILL.md template or full frontmatter example in the evidence, documentation of any optional frontmatter fields.
